verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server, confirmed by a probe of its docs page. It lets Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents query metrics, logs, traces, alerts and dashboards in natural language. Companion Agent Skills and a plugin support the same agent workflow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and details in the pack on setup, authentication and hosted versus self-hosted availability.
